title: RMF Engineer Lead
description:
To acquire the advantage, Zolon is seeking an experienced Risk Management Framework (RMF) Team Lead to lead cybersecurity compliance, Assessment & Authorization (A&A), and Authority to Operate (ATO) activities supporting the Defense Media Activity (DMA) IT Program. The successful candidate will serve as the technical and operational lead for all RMF activities, ensuring compliance with DoD cybersecurity requirements while managing a team of cybersecurity professionals supporting the government's ATO lifecycle.
The RMF Team Lead will act as the primary liaison between ZTI leadership, Government Information System Security Managers (ISSMs), Information System Owners (ISOs), cybersecurity stakeholders, and Authorizing Officials throughout the RMF process.

Primary Responsibilities:
Lead all RMF Rev. 5 activities supporting Assessment & Authorization (A&A) and Authority to Operate (ATO) efforts.
Manage the development, maintenance, and submission of RMF documentation in eMASS.
Serve as the primary technical lead for the RMF team supporting the DMA IT environment.
Coordinate directly with Government ISSMs, ISOs, Security Control Assessors (SCAs), and Authorizing Officials.
Lead preparation for cybersecurity inspections, including:
CSSP Assessments
CORA Reviews
Inspector General (IG) inspections
Cyber Readiness Inspections
Oversee development and maintenance of:
System Security Plans (SSPs)
Security Assessment Reports (SARs)
Security Control Traceability Matrix (SCTM)
Security Assessment Plans (SAPs)
Plans of Action & Milestones (POA&Ms)
Continuous Monitoring Strategy
Security Categorization documentation
Manage security control implementation using NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5.

Leadership Competencies:
The successful candidate should demonstrate:
Strong leadership and team management skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
Ability to lead technical discussions with senior Government stakeholders.
Experience managing competing priorities in a high-visibility DoD environment.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Ability to mentor junior cybersecurity professionals.
Excellent organizational and project management capabilities.
Coordinate vulnerability remediation activities with Infrastructure, Network, System Administration, and Engineering teams.
Track and report cybersecurity metrics to the government leadership.
Review ACAS, SCAP, STIG, and vulnerability scan results and ensure remediation efforts remain on schedule.
Lead cybersecurity working groups and weekly status meetings.
Support annual ATO renewals and Continuous Monitoring (ConMon) activities.
Mentor junior RMF analysts and cybersecurity engineers.
Develop project schedules, staffing priorities, and risk mitigation plans for RMF activities.
Provide executive-level briefings and status reports to Government leadership.

Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
Minimum 10 years of Information Assurance, Cybersecurity, or RMF experience supporting Federal or DoD programs.
Minimum 5 years leading RMF or ATO teams on a Federal Government contract.
Demonstrated experience serving in a leadership position supporting a Government/Contractor relationship, managing personnel, schedules, deliverables, and customer engagement.
Extensive experience supporting DoD Assessment & Authorization (A&A) processes.
Expert knowledge of:
DoD RMF
NIST Risk Management Framework
NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5
DoDI 8510.01
CNSSI 1253
Continuous Monitoring (ConMon)
Extensive experience with eMASS documentation, workflows, package management, and ATO submissions.
Experience coordinating Security Control Assessments (SCAs) and Authorizing Official (AO) packages.

Required Certifications:
CompTIA Security+ CE (or equivalent DoD 8570/8140 baseline certification)
One current DoD CSSP Certification, such as:
CSSP Analyst
CSSP Incident Responder
CSSP Infrastructure Support
CSSP Auditor

Location: Hybrid / Government Site (as required)
Security Clearance: Active Secret Clearance (Required)
